_fixture: Sample General persona in evidence mode, shaped like docs.onairos.io/persona-data-model. Used when the real Onairos request is delayed or unavailable; the UI labels it as sample data.

Curiosity.evidence: You keep asking how things work underneath, not just what they do.

Empathy.evidence: You save and share stories about the people behind a problem.

Persistence.evidence: You return to the same hard topics over months instead of dropping them.

Design sense.evidence: You follow interface and design work closely and comment on the details.

Delegation.evidence: You tend to take on every part of a project yourself.

personality_traits.user_summary: A curious maker who learns by talking to people and returns to hard problems until they make sense.
personality_traits.top_traits_explanation: Curiosity and empathy show up together: you ask questions, and the questions are usually about people.

nudges.text: Ask one person the question you've been sitting on this week.
Share an unfinished draft with someone whose work you admire.
Block one hour to write down what you'd do if the blocker disappeared.

ChatGPT.summary: Questions about research methods and writing.
